title: Establishing Shipping Preferences

children:
A shipping preference record allows you to manage how a user or group 
 of users will ship confirm orders. The default shipping preference record 
 should accommodate the majority of employees. Create specific preference 
 records for employees with unique processing needs.
Auto Print At Load Confirm Checkbox
Create Dock Work On Assigning Load To Dock Door Checkbox

Manifest Unmanifested Containers 
 During Ship Confirm Checkbox

Transfer Failed Shipments 
 During Load Confirmation Checkbox
Provide the preference record a name and a description.

Use the Status Range Fields 
 to define when a shipment line is eligible for ship confirmation. The 
 system will only confirm a shipment line within this range. This 
 range provides you the flexibility to ship confirm lines that are not 
 necessarily in the "Ship Confirm Pending" status. Note that when product 
 is ship confirmed, it moves to the first status after Ship Confirm Pending. 
 Unless you warehouse has specific tasks it completes directly before ship 
 confirmation, the next status will be Ship Confirmed. This insures that 
 product can ship confirmed if it skipped statuses that it either bypassed 
 or does not require and be ship confirmed.

Use the Create 
 Orders From Shipments Checkbox if you want the system to create 
 orders from single shipments entered on the Shipment Screen. This 
 applies to single order entries only. You will enter multiple orders using 
 the Order Entry Window.

If this checkbox is checked, 
 the system will create orders as well as shipments from the Shipment /Shipment 
 Line Screens. The system creates these orders in an "In Process" condition, and are viewable from Trading Partner Management.

NOTE: If this setting is selected, if you manually copy a shipment (and the original shipment has a blank ERP Order Number on the shipment), the system will insert the Shipment ID value into the ERP Order Number field. In addition, the system will also copy this value to the shipment line(s) if they are blank.

If this 
 checkbox is not checked, these 
 windows will just create shipments.

Use the Compute Delivery 
 Date Checkbox to indicate if you want 
 the system to automatically calculate the anticipated delivery date of 
 a shipment using the shipment's "days to deliver" data. For 
 example, suppose you have a shipment that has a scheduled to ship 
 date of Monday, and the shipment should take two days to arrive. Therefore, 
 if this checkbox is selected, the system will calculate that the shipment 
 should arrive at its destination on Wednesday, and populate the appropriate 
 delivery date field on the shipment.

Use the Auto Print At Load Confirm Checkbox to indicate if you want the system to automatically print any/all documents with print process of Shipment or Load. If the default option is checked, auto printing during load confirmation will be enabled.

Use the Create Dock Work On Assigning Load To Dock Door Checkbox to indicate when manually assigning a dock door to a shipping load, whether or not the system will skip the normal "transfer shipping container / create dock management work" processing and instead directly assign the dock door to the load.

Use the Transfer Failed Shipments During 
 Load Confirmation Checkbox

if you want 
 any unconfirmed shipment on a load to be transferred if it fails confirmation 
 during the load confirmation process. The system will then transfer this 
 shipment to a new load, so the original load can be confirmed.

If this checkbox is checked, 
 the system will transfer any unconfirmed shipment to a new load, and confirm 
 the original load.

If this 
 checkbox is not checked, the 
 system will not confirm any load that contains unconfirmed shipments.

Use the Manifest 
 Unmanifested Containers During Ship Confirm Checkbox to indicate, 
 during ship confirmation, if the system should attempt to manifest any 
 containers that are currently unmanifested. Typically, this setting would 
 be used in situations where the shipment and its container(s) have not 
 been closed at the time of ship confirmation.
Use the Split Shipment Mode Field to indicate how you want the system to split shipments/loads when a worker encounters a situation where a split is needed:
: This option will offer the user to decide (during confirmation) from the three options described below.

: This option will only confirm that portion of the shipment that is in a Ready For Ship Confirm status (as defined by the high status in your Shipping Preferences). Any portion of the shipment that is not in this status will be split off to a new shipment with the same shipment ID.
Split Shipment If Not In Range

: This option will confirm the entire shipment as long as it is in the status range defined in your Shipping Preferences. The system will, if needed, update work as lines and containers are transferred to new shipments. If any part of the shipment is outside the status range, this portion will be split off to a new shipment with the same shipment ID.

: This option will not confirm any portion of the shipment if any quantity is in a status less than Ready For Ship Confirm (as defined by the high status in your Shipping Preferences). The shipment will instead be transferred to an alternate load.

Use the Consolidation 
 Field to associate this action with a work type. The system will 
 generate a labor management record (labeled with the selected work type) 
 when the consolidation action is complete.

Use the Auto 
 Work Execution Field to associate this action with a work type. 
 The system will generate a labor management record (labeled with the selected 
 work type) when the load confirmation process needs to execute any outstanding 
 open work instructions. The system needs to address these outstanding 
 instructions before it can confirm a load.

Use the Immediate Dock Transfer Field to indicate the work type that the system will associate with immediate dock transfers  (manual transfers, without work).  The system will use this work type for the writing of transaction history and labor management details when manual transfers of containers are performed.

Use the Assigned 
 Users Tab to associate user profile records with this preference 
 record. When you create the *Default record, the system will automatically 
 select all user profile records that are not already associated with a 
 packing preference record. New users are also automatically associated 
 with the *Default record, unless you associate them with a specific shipping 
 preference record.
